description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of analysis types within the MMAR benchmark dataset. The chart contains ten slices, each representing a different analysis category. These categories are, in clockwise order starting from the top: Content Analysis (light purple), Semantic Layer (41.2%, dark purple), Emotion & Speaker Analysis (blue), Environmental Perception & Reasoning (dark blue), Counting & Statistics (dark teal), Music Theory (teal), Correlation Analysis (green), Spatial Analysis (light green), Temporal Analysis (yellow), and Aesthetic Analysis (orange). The “Cultural Layer” slice is visually emphasized, appearing offset from the rest of the chart and labeled with its proportion, 14.1%. Additionally, the “Anomaly Detection” and “Imagination” slices are very small and labeled with their proportions, 4.3% each. A legend is present, labeling each slice with its corresponding analysis type. Percentage labels are included within the “Semantic Layer” and “Cultural Layer” slices, and the slices appear to be ordered by decreasing size, though this is a visual observation only.
